home.tagline: A file manager that keeps everything in one window.
home.whatText: Yet Another File Manager browses folders in a list or a grid, previews pictures, video and documents beside them, and keeps tabs, a split view, a search, a gallery, per-folder tags and a recycle bin in the same window. It runs on Windows and Linux from the same code base.

features.name: Tabs and split view
features.text: Open several folders at once and show two of them side by side. Tabs remember their own history and the view each folder had.

features.name: List and grid
features.text: Sort by any column, pick the columns you want, and let each folder remember its own list or grid mode, icon size and tile height.

features.name: Previews
features.text: Pictures, video, PDFs and text files appear beside the list or under it. The details panel shows size, dates, link targets and attributes.

features.name: Overview
features.text: A home page made of panels: Quick access, frequent folders, recent items, drives and any folder you pin, in one, two or three columns.

features.name: Search
features.text: A floating find bar that filters as you type, with match case, regular expressions, and a choice between dimming and hiding the rest.

features.name: Tags
features.text: Give files and folders coloured tags, browse them in the catalogue, and rename or remove a tag everywhere at once.

features.name: Gallery
features.text: Point it at the folders that hold pictures and it groups every image by day, with a full-size viewer one double click away.

features.name: Recycle bin
features.text: Restore what you deleted, remove it for good, and see the leftover records whose files are already gone.

features.name: Themes and languages
features.text: Pick the accent and secondary colours, save your own presets, and switch between English, 繁體中文, 简体中文 and 日本語 at any time.

how: Install it, then open a folder. The left sidebar has Quick access, the overview, the gallery and the recycle bin.
Use tabs and split view to keep two folders in sight, and drag the divider to give either side more room.
Right-click anywhere for file operations, and open Settings to change the theme, the columns, the shortcuts and the language.

home.installAfter: ). The Windows build is not code-signed, so Windows may warn the first time.
